name: Anara
summary: AI research workspace (the official rebrand of Unriddle) for uploading papers, chatting with sources, and collaborating on literature work.
description: AI research workspace (the official rebrand of Unriddle) for uploading papers, chatting with sources, and collaborating on literature work.

pricing.details: Free 0 €, no credit card — limited AI usage and uploads, 20 MB or 120 pages per upload, Zotero and Mendeley connectors. Plus 9 €/month, or 7 €/month billed yearly. Pro 18 €/month, or 14 €/month billed yearly. Max 5x 90 €/month, or 72 €/month billed yearly. Max 20x 181 €/month, or 145 €/month billed yearly. All paid prices are per seat, from the official FAQ. Enterprise is custom (contact sales).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Official rebrand of Unriddle: chat and editing over uploaded papers
Free: Zotero and Mendeley connectors, limited usage, no card
Plus adds science databases (including PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov); Pro adds OCR, model choice and cloud connectors; Max adds Deep Search and Model Council
Prices per seat are taken from the official FAQ (Plus / Pro / Max 5x / Max 20x)
